page.overview:
Who is Domina?

Satan Invincible|status=Alive|Only Appearance=|relatives=Unnamed Father Damien Darkblood (brother)|voice=Kate Mulgrew|First Appearance=|Latest Appearance=|occupation=|title=Domina|first appearance=|enemies=Volcanikka Magmanites|home=Hell|only appearance=4x04 "Hurm"}}Domina is a supporting character that appears in Season 4. She's Damien Darkblood's sister and a member of the Darkblood Clan.

Domina is a demon with a mostly humanoid figure, but with red skin, pointed ears and teeth, and a tail. unlike her brother, she has a fit build. Like the rest of known demons, she has body suit, and black metal armor. She has a high ponytail.

Domina has a caring and focused mindset, focused on defeating Volkanica, but showing concern for when her brother in injured.
